checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Uses attached cat photo, same cat and sofa
must.why: Cat and sofa look identical to the original; the output is slightly re-rendered but the same.
Reads WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY.

must.item: Large white letters, black outlines, visible, readable
must.why: Bold white caps with black outlines, fully in frame. The outline is thin on the top text, but it is still readable.
Eyes are clear and the image is 640x640 square.

faults.what: The top text sits close to the top edge and the ear tips, and its letters are tightly spaced. It is still legible.
The image looks slightly re-rendered and sharpened compared with the original photo, and the whiskers look a little different.

summary: The meme is a clean square image of the original cat with both captions spelled exactly right in bold white letters with black outlines, and the cat's eyes are clear.
